summary: Iteration 6 - full Phase-1 mobile client verification (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (26 pytest cases covering auth, patient CRUD, reports upload+OCR, doctor patients list, cross-role 403 isolation, OTP rate limit 429, insights, legacy /api/documents regression). 25/26 pass; 1 failure exposes a real CRITICAL backend bug (see below). Ran Playwright scripts at 390x844 for splash-login-OTP-patient dashboard, tab bar, reports filters, insights, profile with masked Aadhaar, upload rejection + happy-path OCR, new-patient registration, duplicate-Aadhaar UI check, onboarding-skip, patient logout, and doctor flow (home/patients/search/detail/profile/logout). Every mobile flow in the review request works with correct testIDs, correct copy, correct masking, and correct 422 rejection message. Legacy Dialygo web app still renders the 'Choose your workspace' screen at /.

critical.issue: scripts/seed_mobile.py does NOT call load_dotenv() before importing services.security, so seeded Patient rows are hashed with the DEFAULT AADHAAR_PEPPER ('dialygo-dev-pepper-change-in-production') while the running backend (server.py DOES call load_dotenv) uses the value from backend/.env ('dialygo-dev-aadhaar-pepper-rotate-in-production'). Result: hash_aadhaar('123456789012') at seed time = e96bfbc1... but at API-request time = acc2524e42981686..., so the clash check select(Patient).where(aadhaar_hash == aadhaar_hash) never matches the seeded Ravi Kumar row. First registration attempt with the seeded Aadhaar from a NEW mobile SUCCEEDS with 200 and silently creates a duplicate Patient. Verified reproducibly in DB: Ravi Kumar hash=e96bfbc1... but a fresh /api/patient/register call inserted a new row with hash=acc2524e... for the same 123456789012 input. Ravi's patient_identifier ('DG-E96BFBC19012') is also derived from the wrong-pepper hash. Fix: add `from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / '.env')` at the very top of scripts/seed_mobile.py BEFORE any core/services imports, then delete any stale patient rows and re-seed.

integration_issues.flow: Reload after logout on the mobile web preview
integration_issues.issue: After logout the URL is /mobile/auth/login (correct). Browser reload from that URL is served by the CRA dev server and shows the LEGACY web app's 'Choose your workspace' page (because Expo web deep links other than /mobile/index.html are not statically served). Re-visiting /mobile/index.html shows the login screen (session IS cleared). This is documented behaviour in the review note ('Deep links like /mobile/patient are NOT served by the CRA dev server'), so not a blocker, but end users must be sent back to /mobile/index.html by any post-logout link. Consider serving all /mobile/* paths from mobile/index.html.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix scripts/seed_mobile.py to load_dotenv() before importing services.security; wipe & re-seed so Ravi Kumar's aadhaar_hash and patient_identifier are recomputed with the real pepper. Otherwise duplicate-Aadhaar detection against the seeded patient is silently broken and DUP registrations succeed. Reproduce: on a fresh DB, POST /api/auth/send-otp+verify-otp with any unused 9-digit mobile, then POST /api/patient/register {name,'aadhaar_number':'123456789012'} -> returns 200/created instead of the required 409. Same bug is why iteration_6 backend test 'test_duplicate_aadhaar_conflict' fails on the first run and passes on subsequent runs (because the first successful registration inserts a real-pepper hashed row).
MINOR: Consider adding a rewrite rule so /mobile/* paths fall back to /mobile/index.html; otherwise a browser hard-refresh on any in-app route lands on the legacy web app.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/scripts/seed_mobile.py: missing load_dotenv() -> pepper mismatch (see critical bug).

backend/core/config.py + backend/services/security.py: hash_aadhaar uses a pepper sourced from env with a hard-coded default fallback. Any code path that imports settings before load_dotenv silently gets the fallback pepper, and any Patient row created in that path will never match. Options: (a) fail-fast if AADHAAR_PEPPER is not explicitly set, (b) add load_dotenv inside core/config.py, or (c) at minimum add a startup assertion.

backend/routers/reports.py: get_checker().check(sample_text(...)) is called synchronously inside an async endpoint. sample_text on PDFs uses PyMuPDF which can block the event loop for large uploads; consider asyncio.to_thread.
mobile: no visible dev-otp-banner check needed because the banner already renders the code (verified). Good.
Aadhaar handling is correct end-to-end: full 12-digit value never leaves the backend, profile always shows 'XXXX XXXX 9012', dashboard/profile responses do not contain the raw digits.

rca of the issue: Pepper mismatch RCA: (1) backend/server.py imports load_dotenv and calls it at module load; therefore uvicorn workers evaluate os.environ['AADHAAR_PEPPER'] before importing routers -> settings.aadhaar_pepper = value from .env. (2) scripts/seed_mobile.py does NOT call load_dotenv, but imports services.security -> settings.aadhaar_pepper resolves from bare os.environ which does not contain AADHAAR_PEPPER (supervisor's environment= line only sets APP_URL and INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL; the shell that runs `python -m scripts.seed_mobile` also does not export it) -> falls back to the default. (3) hash_aadhaar therefore produces two different HMAC-SHA256 digests for the same Aadhaar depending on which entrypoint touched the DB. (4) The uniqueness/clash check compares aadhaar_hash column values verbatim -> seeded row is invisible to /api/patient/register. Mitigation: load_dotenv() at the top of every entrypoint script, or better, move load_dotenv into core/config.py so any import path is safe.
